m: अभि-√ राध् Caus. -राधयति, to propitiate, conciliate, ŚBr. &c.: Caus. Pass. -राध्यते, to be rendered propitious, R. : Caus. Desid. -रिराधयिषति, to intend to render propitious, ŚBr.
a: अभिराध् — Caus. To propitiate; Śi. 7. 1.

m: अभि-राद्ध mfn. rendered propitious, propitiated, conciliated, Śiś. i, 71.
a: अभिराद्ध — a. Propitiated, pleased Śi. 1. 71.

v: tri॰ aBito rAjate aBi + rAja + kvip । 1 aDikadIptiSIle 2 aDISvare ca ।
m: 1. अभि-√ राज् -राजते, to shine, be brilliant, MBh. iii, 10960.
2. अभि-राज् mfn. reigning everywhere, Kauś.
a: अभिराज् — a. Reigning everywhere, supreme.

m: अभि-राज m. N. of a Burmese king.

s: tri, (aBiramate mano'tra, aBi + ram + ADAre GaY .) ruciraH । sundaraH । iti hemacandraH ॥ (manoharaH । manojYaH । ramaRIyaH । AnandakaraH । “mano'BirAmAH SfRvantO raTanemisvanonmuKEH” । iti raGuvaMSe .)
v: pu॰ aBiramyate'smin rama + ADAre GaY । 1 sundare 2 priye, 3 manohare ca । “SrotrABirAmAH SfRvantO raTanemisvanonmuKEH” “SrotrABirAmaDvaninA raTena “yasyAtmagehe nayanABirAmaH” iti ca raGuH grIvABaNgABirAmaM muhuranupatati svandane dattadfzwiH Saku॰ । “rAma ityaBirAmeRa vapuzA tasya noditaH” raGuH ।
m: अभि-राम mf(आ)n. pleasing, delightful, agreeable, beautiful
अभि-राम m. N. of Śiva
a: अभिराम — a. 1 Pleasing, delightful, sweet, agreeable; मनोभिरामाः (केकाः) R. 1. 39; 2. 72; 6. 47; Ki. 6. 30. --2 Beautiful, lovely, graceful, charming; स्यादस्थांनोपगतयमुनासंगमेवाभिरामा Me. 51; कुमारा माराभिरामाः Dk. 10; ˚त्वं प्रमदवनस्य V. 2; राम इत्यभिरामेण वपुषा तस्य चोदितः R. 10. 67, 13. 32; K. 145; Mv. 5. 47-8. Ś. 3. 26 --मः An epithet of Śiva. --मं ind. 1 Gracefully, beautifully; ग्रीवाभंगभिरामं दत्तदृष्टिः Ś. 1. 7. --2 Referring to Rāma.

m: 1. अभि-रामम् ind. so as to be agreeable to (in comp.), Śāk.; (for 2. अभि-रामम् See s.v. below.)
2. अभि-रामम् ind. referring to Rāma.
अभि-राम—मणि n. N. of a drama of Sundaramiśra (cf. Wilson, Hindu Theatre, ii, 395.)
अभि-राम—पशुपति m. N. of a poet.
अभि-राम—ता f. loveliness, beauty, Śiś. i, 16, &c.
the state of being agreeable to (in comp.), Mcar.
अभि-राम—त्व n. = -ता.
अभि-राष्ट्र mfn. overpowering or conquering dominions, RV. x, 174, 5.
a: अभिराष्ट्र — a. Ved. Who has gained dominion or supremacy.

m: अभि-√ रै to bark towards (acc.), TĀr.

s: puM, (aBilakzyaM rUpamasya .) paRqitaH । iti hemacandraH ॥ kAmadevaH । candraH । SivaH । vizRuH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥
tri, (aBirUpayati SAstrArTaM nirUpayati, aBirUpa + Ric + ac .) manoharaH । paRqitaH । iti medinI ॥ (“iyaM hi rasaBAvaviSezadIkzAguroH vikramAdityasyABirUpaBUyizWA parizad” । iti SAkuntale .)
v: tri॰ aBirUpayati sarvaM svAtmakaM karoti cu॰ rUpaac । 1 Sive, 2 vizRO ca । aBirUpayati nirUpayati । 3 paRqite । utkfzwaM rUpaM yasya । 4 kandarpe, 5 candre ca । 6 manohare tri॰ । “utkfzwAyABirUpAya varAya sadfSAya ca” manuH । “aBirUpaguRaBUyizWA parizat” Saku॰ 7 anurUpe tri॰ “kAmamanaBirUpramasyA vayaso valkalam” Saku॰ । aBirUpasya BAvaH manojYA॰ vuY ABirUpakam zyaY ABirUpyaYca sOndaryyAdO na॰ । “arcakasya tapoyogAdarcanasyAtiSAyanAt । ABirUpyAcca vimbAnAM devaH sAnniDyamfcCati” ti॰ ta॰ pu॰ ।
m: अभि-रूप mf(आ)n. corresponding with (dat.), conformable to, ŚBr.; AitBr.
pleasing, handsome, beautiful, AV. viii, 9, 9; Mn. &c.
wise, learned, Mn. iii, 144; Śāk.
अभि-रूप m. the moon, L.
Śiva, L.
Viṣṇu, L.
Kāmadeva, L.
a: अभिरूप — a. [अभिगतो रूपं] 1 Corresponding with, conformable or suitable to, congruous; अभिरूपमस्या वयसो वल्कलं Ś. 1. v. l. --2 Pleasing, delightful, handsome, charming, beautiful, well-formed; अभिरूपेणापि स्वदारसंतुष्टेन K. 51; उत्कृष्टायाभिरूपाय वराय सदृशाय च (कन्यां दद्यात्) Ms. 9. 88. --3 Dear to, beloved or liked by, favourite; यो यः प्रदेशः सख्या मेऽभिरूपः Ś. 6. --4 Learned, wise, enlightened; अभिरूपभूयिष्ठा परिषदियं Ś. 1; K. 78; Ms. 3. 144. --पः 1 The moon. --2 Śiva. --3 Viṣṇu. --4 Cupid, --Comp. --पतिः ‘having an agreeable husband,’ N. of a fast or rite performed to secure a good husband in the next world; Mk. 1.

k.v: तल्पं शय्याट्टदारेषु स्तम्बेऽपि विटपोऽस्त्रियाम्. प्राप्तरूपस्वरूपाभिरूपा बुधमनोज्ञयोः॥
तल्पं शय्याट्टदारेषु स्तम्बेऽपि विटपोऽस्त्रियाम्. प्राप्तरूपस्वरूपाभिरूपा बुधमनोज्ञयोः॥

m: अभिरूप—भूयिष्ठ mfn. for the most part composed of learned men, Śak.
अभि-रूपक mfn. = अभि-रूप, Pāṇ. viii, 1, 8, Sch.
(g. श्रेण्य्-आदि and श्रमणादि, q.v.)
a: अभिरूपक — = अभिरूप q. v.

m: अभि-रूप—पति m. ‘having an agreeable master’, (a rite) to secure such a master in the next world, L.
अभिरूप—प्रजायिनी f. the mother of beautiful children, MBh.
अभि-रूप—ता f. the state of being learned or well educated, Kād.
अभि-रूप—वत् mfn. handsome, beautiful, MBh. iii, 10070.
अभि-√ रभ् Ā. (perf. 3. pl. -रेभिरे) to embrace, BhP. : Caus. perf. Pass. p. -रम्भित See below.

a: अभिरंज् — {{pass.->Pass.||20260624|Dr. Dhaval Patel|https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/issues/692|}} 1 To be coloured or tinted. --2 To be flushed or greatly delighted, exult. --Caus. To tinge, colour, tint.
अभिरंजनं — Colouring.

m: अभि-रश्मिमालि ind. towards the sun, ib.
अभि-√ रञ्ज् -रज्यते, to be pleased with (instr.) : Caus. P. ‘to colour’ (cf. अभि-रञ्जित).
अभि-रञ्जित mfn. tinted, coloured, R.
अभि-रक्त mfn. devoted to, MBh. &c.
a: अभिरक्त — p. p. Devoted, intent, attached.

m: अभि-√ रक्ष् P. Ā. -रक्षति, ˚ते (p. -रक्षमाण, RV. x, 157, 4) to guard, protect, preserve, RV. &c.; ‘to govern or command’ (cf. अभि-रक्षित).
a: अभिरक्ष् — {c1c} P. 1 To protect, preserve, keep, guard, help; भीष्ममेवाभिरक्षंतु Bg. 1. 10, 11. --2 To rule over, govern (as earth &c.); command.

m: अभि-रक्षा f. protection, VarBṛS.
a: अभिरक्षा, --रक्षणं — Universal or complete protection; protection in every quarter; प्रशांतबाधं दिशतोऽभिरक्षया Ki. 1. 18.

v: na॰ aBito rakzaRam । mantrAdinA sarvvataH Sveta sarzapAdivikzepEH yAtuDAnAdiByo 1 rakzaRe 2 sardvato rakzaRe cABAve a । aBirakzApyatra strI । “praSAntabADaM diSato'BirakzayA” kirA॰ ।
m: अभि-रक्षण n. guarding, protection, MBh. &c.
अभि-रक्षित mfn. protected, preserved, guarded
governed, commanded, Bhag. &c.

v: tri॰ aBitorakzati tfc striyAM NIp । sarvato rakzake “varRRAnAmASramARAYcarAjA sfzwo'BirakzitA” manuH
m: अभि-रक्षितृ mfn. one who preserves, a protector of (gen.), Mn. vii, 35.
a: अभिरक्षितृ — a. Protecting, guarding.

m: अभि-रक्ष्य mfn. to be protected, VarBṛS.
अभि-√ रम् -रमते, to dwell, ĀśvGṛ.; to repose, ŚāṅkhGṛ.; Mn. iii, 251; Yājñ. i, 251; to delight in, be delighted, MBh. &c. Caus. -रामयति, to gladden, MBh. &c.; to delight in, to be delighted.
a: अभिरम् — {c1c} A. (rarely P.) 1 To be pleased or delighted (with loc.); दृष्टिरिहाभिरमते हृदयं च Mk. 4, 5. 15; न गंधहरिणो दमनककेदारिकायामभिरमति Vb. 3; Ratn. 2, Y. 1. 252. --2 To please or gratify oneself, take pleasure or delight in (with loc.); विद्यासु विद्वानिव सोभिरेमे Bk. 1. 9. --Caus. To gratify, please; मत्सपत्नीरभिरमयिष्यसि Dk. 90, 92, 163.

m: अभि-रम्भित mfn. embraced, BhP.
seized by (acc.!), BhP.
अभि-रमणीय mfn. delightful.
अभि-रमण n. delighting in, delighting.
a: अभिरमणं — Delighting in.

v: tri॰ aBiramate BfSaM ramate'tra AGAre yat । manorame ।

m: अभि-√ 1. रस् to neigh towards (acc.), KātyŚr.

v: tri॰ aBimusvatayA BfSaM vA rataH । 1 atyAntAsakte 2 aBimuKatayA rate ca ।
m: अभि-रत mfn. reposing, Yājñ. i, 251
pleased or contented with (loc.), satisfied
engaged in, attentive to (loc.), performing, practising.
a: अभिरत — p. p. 1 Glad, delighted, satisfied, Śi. 10. 55, 89. --2 Engaged in, devoted or attached to; performing, practising; Bg. 18. 45. --3 Attentive to.

v: strI aBito ratiH prA॰ sa॰ । AsaktO “na mfgayABiratirnadurodaram” raGuH ।
m: अभि-रति f. pleasure, delighting in (loc. or in comp.), Ragh. ix, 7, &c.
N. of a world, Buddh.
a: अभिरतिः — f. 1 Pleasure, delight, satisfaction; attachment or devotion to; न मृगयाभिरतिर्न दुरोदरं (तमपाहरत्) R. 9. 7; Ki. 6. 44. --2 Practice, occupation.

m: अभि-√ रिभ् -रेभति, to howl towards (acc.), BhP. (v.l. for अभि- √ 1. रु, q.v.)
अभि-√ रिष् (Subj. -रेषात्) to fail, miscarry, AV. iv, 35, 1.
अभि-रोद्धृ mfn. one who wards off, MaitrS.
अभि-रोरुद mfn. causing tears (indicative of strong passion), AV. vii, 38, 1.
अभि-रोरुद See अभि-रुदित.
a: अभिरोरुद — a. Ved. Causing tears (of joy or earnest desire).

m: अभि-√ 1. रु -रौति (v.l. -रेभति) to roar or howl towards (acc.), BhP.; (Imper. 2. sg. -रुव), AV. v, 20, 3.
अभि-√ रुध् to keep off, MBh. viii, 4308.

अभि-√ रुच् Ā. to be bright, shine, R.; MārkP.; to please any one (dat.), Vikr. : Caus. P. to delight, amuse, MBh. xiii, 476 (v.l. अभि-√ रम्, Caus.) : P. Ā. to be pleased with, approve of, be inclined to, like, MBh. &c.
a: अभिरुच् — {c1c} A. 1 To shine, look finely; धर्मोऽभिरोचते यस्माद्धर्मराजस्ततः स्मृतः Mārk. P. --2 To like, desire; यदभिरोचते or अभिरुचितं भवते V. 2 --Caus. To be inclined to, have a taste or liking for, long, desire or wish for.

v: pu॰ BfSA atyantA ruciH prA॰ sa॰ । 1 atyantarucO
m: अभि-रुचि f. delighting in, being pleased with (loc. or in comp.), BhP. &c.
a: अभिरुचिः — f. 1 Desire, taste, liking, relish, delight, pleasure; यशसि चाभिरुचिः Bh. 2. 63; परस्पराभिरुचिनिष्पन्नो विवाहः K. 367. --2 Desire of fame, ambition; splendour.

m: अभि-रुचिर mfn. very bright, R. iii, 39, 5.
a: अभिरुचिर — a. Very pleasant or agreeable, beautiful, splendid.

m: अभि-रुचित mfn. pleasing, agreeable to
pleased with, delighting in (loc. or in comp.) (cf. यथाभिरुचित)
अभि-रुचित m. N. of a prince of the Vidyādharas, Kathās.
a: अभिरुचित — p. p. Liked, beloved. --तः A lover; Śi. 10. 68.

m: अभि-रुदित mfn. cried, uttered in a lamenting manner, R.
अभि-रुह् (perf. 3. pl. -रुरुहुः) to ascend, mount, RV. v, 7, 5, &c.
अभि-रुह्य ind.p. having ascended.
अभि-रुत mfn. filled with roaring or any noise, resounding with (in comp.), MBh. &c.
अभि-रुत n. cries, R.
singing (as of birds), R.
a: अभिरुत — a. Sounded, vocal; cooed (as the voices of birds &c.). --तं A sound, cry, noise.

m: अभि-रुषित mfn. very angry, MBh. viii, 1747.
